intro: Discover the perfect mix of bounce and stability with the Insignia. Its spring core and quilted fabric cradle you in comfort, while firm edges and a sleek design elevate your sleep experience.

features.title: Sleep support that adjusts with you
features.text: End sleepless nights with a mattress that hugs your body, providing all-night support and pressure relief—because you deserve to wake up refreshed.

features.title: Foam that adapts for personalised comfort
features.text: Your body is unique—your mattress should be too. The Insignia gently cradles you with adaptive foam that responds to your shape, easing pressure points for personalised comfort all night long.

features.title: Gentle foam for cozy relaxation
features.text: The soft PU foam layer cradles your body with plush comfort, relieving pressure points and creating a cozy, inviting surface for restful, uninterrupted sleep.

features.title: Quilted fabric for plush relaxation
features.text: With its soft, breathable fabric, our mattress cover enhances airflow while delivering a cosy, welcoming surface you’ll love sinking into.

features.title: Perfect fit for any bed size
features.text: Our perfectly tailored dimensions adapt effortlessly to your space, ensuring a snug, seamless fit for beds of all sizes—no awkward gaps or loose edges.
